comment: kiln.content's limits registry (dev.32 registry-r3b): limits the game's code holds as fixed numbers, answered by Kiln's own hooks behind registry fields (regmap/common/limits.json). limits/AltarLimit is the game's altar-limit function: min(BalancingTable.altarsPerFlameLevel[flameLevel], 16), BalancingRegistry* in rcx, the Flame level in edx, the limit in eax (0x93dea0 on this build; the same bytes on both sides); limits/altars.cap is its 16 (an immediate, in both of the function's paths) and limits/altars.table the table's offset of altarsPerFlameLevel. limits/GiftRange is the gifting distance getter (0x93de70): movss xmm0,[rip+d]; ret, the squared distance (2500 = 50 m), pinned at the host's gift check (0x19e9f9: mulss, addss, call, comiss, ja), as XHL's Unlimited Gifting Range finds it. Evidence: docs/re/build.md section 13.
